data.headline: $85 | 2 Hours | Boston Common Winter Lights Night Tour
data.description:
#Boston Common Winter Lights Night Tour
##Capture the colorful holiday lights illuminating the city of Boston!
_________________________________

Dazzling lights are illuminating the city of Boston. Discover the creative ways to photograph them on a PhotoWalks Night Tour. 

Learn the long exposure settings that result in fun, festive images of the many photo ops in the Boston Common, the oldest park in America!

Bring your camera, tripod and enthusiasm for increasing your night photography skills.

Tour is limited to 8 participants.
_________________________________
##Price

• **Adults:** $80

All skill levels are welcome.
data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellation Policy#

Full refund or credit with at least 24 hours notice by customer.

Full refund or credit if a tour is canceled by PhotoWalks due to weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances. 

No refunds for no-shows.
data.booking_notes:
##Details

**Duration**
• 2 hours

• Please plan to arrive at least 10 minutes before the start time. Your punctuality is appreciated. Thank you. 

NOTE: If you are running late, please send a text to 617-851-2273 so you can meet up with the group. Phone calls will not be answered after a tour begins. 

**Meeting Point**
Brewer Fountain - Boston Common - facing Tremont St and adjacent to Park St. subway stop

 **Parking** :  Boston Common Garage - 0 Charles Street, Boston, MA 

**Train Stop**
• Park Street (Green Line or Red Line). 

**What to Bring**
• Digital Camera
• Tripod
• Extra camera battery (strongly recommended)
• Lens cloth (optional)
• Bottled Water

There are NO RESTROOM stops.
